cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(RFPSPortable VERSION 0.2.0 LANGUAGES CXX)
if(NOT WIN32)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "RFPS Portable targets Windows 10/11 x64.")
endif()
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
add_executable(RFPS WIN32 src/main.cpp)
target_compile_definitions(RFPS PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN NOMINMAX)
target_compile_options(RFPS PRIVATE /W4 /permissive- /EHsc)
target_link_libraries(RFPS PRIVATE d3d11 dxgi d3dcompiler user32 gdi32)
